description: AI crawler visits to your site: totalCrawls; bots, each crawler with its botName, kind (search, user or training, for ChatGPT's, Claude's and Perplexity's crawlers) and crawlCount, most crawls first; and daily, each day with crawls, oldest first, with its crawlCount and the count per crawler (byBot). Null, with a hint, until the Analytics screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen) or while no AI crawler source is selected (get_analytics_sources). The same numbers as Analytics' AI Crawling tab.
name: get_ai_crawling
